messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style 60-second Mario Kart time trial game on one track.

## Requirements
- Implement the game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained HTML Canvas game with a scenic pseudo-3D circuit and solo time-trial gameplay.
- Used original “Turbo Circuit” branding rather than Mario Kart assets or branding.
- Included WASD/arrow controls, drift and boost, coins, lap tracking, a 60-second countdown, and mobile touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html`.
- JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check /tmp/game.js`.
- Browser smoke test confirmed the start screen loads and gameplay updates timer and speed.
- Saved and inspected screenshot at `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- Browser check reported a 404 resource error, likely for the favicon; no gameplay errors were observed.
- No full-length race or end-of-time results screen test has been run.

## Next Move
1. Optionally investigate the 404 and run a complete 60-second playthrough to verify finish/results behavior.
2. Finish with a brief summary of the game and note the assumption that “Mario Kart” meant a kart-racing-inspired game using original assets.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local preview server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Final gameplay smoke test showed timer `57.5`, speed `115`, lap `01`, coins `00`.

content.text:
Built the playable time trial in `index.html`. It features a pseudo-3D circuit, a 60-second timer, lap and coin tracking, drift boosts, keyboard and touch controls, and a results screen. I also fixed a missing favicon that caused a 404.

**Checks:** JavaScript syntax passed; browser smoke tests confirmed gameplay updates and the results screen appears when time runs out. The results-screen check used an accelerated test clock, not a full 60-second playthrough. The latest screenshot is `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

**Assumption:** I interpreted “Mario Kart” as a kart-racing-inspired game and used original Turbo Circuit branding and visuals.
